title: Consumer-price-adjusted construction cost index for new single-family houses
description: Census constant-quality construction cost divided by CPI-U and normalized to 2005.
question: How quickly are costs to build a comparable home changing?
transformation: Census fixed-weight construction cost index divided by monthly CPI-U; 2005 CPI average = 100
sourceName: U.S. Census Bureau and HUD Survey of Construction; BLS CPI-U via FRED
